product_lock_block: - Use the uploaded Obesity Killer product packshot images as absolute visual truth.
- Use provided product references as exact appearance truth for pack shape, label, and color.
- Do not redesign, redraw, relabel, or alter any product or packaging in any way.
- Do not change brand name, label colors, illustrations, proportions, or any text (Hindi or English).
- If any label text is unclear, preserve the original image as-is. Do not reinterpret it.
- Only permitted: placement, scaling, subtle drop shadows, mild warm lighting correction.

style_descriptions.HERO: HERO, polished enough for paid ad deployment.

output_spec_lines: - Full-bleed requirement: scene must reach all canvas edges; no inset poster card, no inner frame, no side matte bands, no faux border margins.
- Text policy: low text by default; all copy minimal and mobile-readable at 375px width.
- Rendering: no compression artifacts; no soft edges on text or product labels.
- All 5 products present, proportionally sized per reference dimensions, unmodified.
- Readability: maintain high-contrast foreground/background treatment for ad-platform legibility.
negative_constraints: - Do not recreate or redraw any product.
- Do not blur, approximate, or rewrite any label text.
- Do not use sale badges, burst graphics, or stickers.
- Do not show body transformations or weight-loss visuals.
- Do not use colors outside the defined palette.
- Do not use more than 2 font weights.
- Do not add edge glows, tinted borders, amber/orange side casts, or decorative vignette frames.
- Do not create inset-canvas look: no white frame border, no inner-card composition, no side fade bands, no outer padding effect.
- Do not shrink main scene inside margins; composition must remain full-bleed to all four edges.
- Do not place any translucent white panel behind or below the product cluster.
- Do not make medical cure claims of any kind.
- Do not use ring light, studio flash, or overproduced lighting.
ugc_extra_constraints: - Do not render unnatural or anatomically incorrect hands.
- Do not show the creator holding, grabbing, lifting, opening, pinching, or touching any product, bottle, packet, jar, or kit box; products must rest independently on the surface at correct scale.
ba_extra_constraint: - Do not render literal BEFORE:/AFTER: words anywhere on-image.
quality_bar_lines: - All 5 products present, correctly proportioned, and completely unmodified.
- All on-image text sharp and readable at 375px mobile size.
- Product labels accurate, unmodified, and fully readable.
- No clutter, no hype, and no forbidden elements.
- Single clear focal hierarchy aligned with the selected visual archetype.
- If any item above fails, regenerate immediately without compromise.
visual_direction_lines: - Text panel treatment: if used, keep panel in upper text zone only with vertical fade to transparent before products; never place white panel behind or below product cluster.
- Edge color control: keep border tones neutral and natural; no orange/amber edge tint and no ornamental frame glow.
- Edge structure control: enforce full-bleed composition to edges; reject outputs with visible inset border, side matte strip, or inner-frame card look.
hero_anti_convergence_rule: - HERO anti-convergence rule: obey the selected archetype literally. Do not fall back to generic centered headline + centered product composition unless the chosen archetype is the centered variant.
ba_panel_anchors: - BEFORE panel visual anchors: include at least 2 struggle cues (messy surface, unplanned snack context, low-clarity routine signals).
- AFTER panel visual anchors: include at least 2 control cues (clean setup, fixed-step context, calmer brighter environment).
- Identity continuity: if a person is shown, keep same person across both panels; change only mood/context, never fake body transformation.
visual_match_lock: - VISUAL MATCH LOCK (from base 4:5): keep same subject identity, camera feel, lighting direction, prop family, and product arrangement; only adjust spacing/scale for aspect-ratio fit.
visual_match_lock_916: - For 9:16 conversion: preserve the same product left-right order and relative layering as base 4:5; allow only vertical re-spacing and minor scale adaptation.
typography_lines: - Headline: Poppins Bold with high contrast against clean background area.
- Support and CTA: Poppins Medium/Regular, same family.
- Size: readable on a 375px mobile screen without zooming.
- Placement: flat uncluttered zones only; avoid noisy textures.
- Forbidden: thin fonts, script fonts, decorative typefaces, glow effects, outlined text, drop shadows on copy.
- Mandatory: crisp hard text edges, zero softness, zero anti-alias blur on any character.
- If any text is soft, blurry, or illegible, discard and regenerate immediately.
typography_extra_lines: Keep on-image text minimal and mobile-readable. Avoid dense copy blocks.
Render CTA as a real filled button chip with rounded corners and strong contrast; never show CTA as standalone plain text.
Typography must be pin-sharp. If any text appears soft, blurry, or smeared, regenerate.
Keep text count minimal and increase font size rather than packing more copy.
Use clean sans typography with strong stroke clarity; no thin/light weights for body text.
Use Poppins only for on-image text: Headline in Poppins Bold, support/CTA in Poppins Medium/Regular.
safezone_45:
SAFE-ZONE ENFORCEMENT (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
- Frame: 1080x1350 (4:5).
- Restricted bands: top 10% (0-135px), bottom 15% (1148-1350px), side edges outer 8% (0-86px and 994-1080px).
- Keep all products and all on-image text fully inside the central safe field: x=86-994 and y=135-1148.
- Product cluster may be centered or left/right weighted according to the selected archetype, with mild upward bias allowed, but must not touch any restricted band.
- Reject and regenerate if any headline, CTA, or product detail crosses restricted zones.
- HARD DIMENSION LOCK: output must be exactly 1080×1350 pixels. If the generated image is any other size or aspect ratio, reject and regenerate until it matches exactly 1080×1350.
safezone_916:
SAFE-ZONE ENFORCEMENT (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
- Keep all critical content inside the 14%-65% vertical safe band.
- Reserve the lower 35% as quiet space; no product labels or headline copy in this band.
- Keep side margins clean; no key content touching left or right frame edges.
- Product cluster may be centered or left/right weighted according to the selected archetype, but must remain fully inside safe zones.
- Reject and regenerate if any headline, CTA, or product detail crosses restricted zones.
outpaint_lock:
9:16 CONVERSION LOCK (OUTPAINT ONLY)
- Treat base 4:5 composition as fixed ground truth; preserve it exactly.
- Extend canvas vertically only; top/bottom extension zones are background only.
- Do not stretch, warp, zoom, crop, or recomposite existing content.
- Keep product cluster size, spacing, and relative proportions identical to base 4:5.
- Keep product cluster anchored at roughly same visual vertical position (~45%).
- Keep headline/support/CTA hierarchy and spacing tight; do not add vertical gaps.
- Keep all critical text+product content inside the central active band; do not push into extension zones.
- If any distortion, spacing drift, or repositioning appears, reject and regenerate.

subject_lines.UGC: Same adult subject identity appears in both panels: left shows routine struggle, right shows practical control; no body-shaming or body-morph visuals.
subject_lines.BA: Same adult subject identity appears in both panels: left shows routine struggle, right shows practical control; no body-shaming or body-morph visuals.

action_lines.UGC: Products arranged on a clean table/counter at correct scale; creator may point or gesture near them but must not touch, hold, grab, lift, or open any product or box.
action_lines.BA: Split action: BEFORE panel shows rushed/impulsive routine cue; AFTER panel shows one clear repeatable step with cleaner setup and calmer behavior.
action_lines.default: Arrange all 5 products as a cohesive premium cluster; kit box acts as anchor.

camera_lines.UGC: Handheld close-to-medium framing, phone-like realism, stable focus on labels.
camera_lines.default: Eye-level medium framing with clean edge discipline.

realism_lines.UGC: True-to-life proportions; no stock-template look; natural skin and correct hand anatomy.

props_default: Minimal, non-competing; keep edge zones quiet.
surfaces_default: Premium, clean texture; avoid busy patterns under text.
mood_default: Calm confidence and practical consistency; no hype.
